data.name: Any%
data.rules:
- Beat the game as fast as possible
- Timing begins when you select a character on a new file
- Timing ends when the score on the final flagpole in "The Great Tower of Bowser Land" appears
- If you have a catsuit on when touching the last pole, you must wait till you grab the pole and the score appears
- All runs must begin on a new profile
- Using multiple controllers is allowed

data.name: 380 Stars
data.rules:
- Collect all 380 stars in the game
- Timing begins when you select a character on a new file
- Timing ends when the star counter hits 380 on the world map
- All runs must begin on a new profile
- Using multiple controllers is allowed

- Get all 5 stars on your save file. Complete all levels with all green stars, all stamps, all golden flagpoles, and with every character
- Timing begins when you select a character on a new file
- Timing ends when the final stamp needed hits the stamp collection
- All runs must begin on a new profile
- Using multiple controllers is allowed

data.name: Mario% No Powerups
data.rules:
- Beat the game using only Mario
- Beat the game using no powerups
- These include: Mushrooms, Tanooki Leaf, Invincible Tanooki Leaf, Super Bell, Boomerang, and Fire Flower
- If you happen to grab a powerup, you must exit the level
- You may grab 1UP mushrooms
- You may use the checkpoint to power up
- Temporary items are allowed: Mega Mushroom, Double Cherry, and Stars

- Timing begins when you select Mario on a new file
- Timing ends when the score on the final flagpole in "The Great Tower of Bowser Land" appears
- All runs must begin on a new profile
- Using multiple controllers is NOT allowed
